Casey (PM): Sharing new mock for the Private setup wizard — focused on the networking step, preflight checks, and the empty/error states. Link: https://figma.redwood/mock-priv-setup Milo (Design): Nice! First pass: the network status chips feel visually noisy when stacked. Can we collapse to a single summary line with an expand chevron? Ava (Product): Agree on decluttering. Also the copy for the prereq failures reads as a user-facing error rather than an actionable tip. Example: "Connectivity check failed" -> "Unable to reach the host. Try these steps: ..." Sam (Frontend): Re: collapse, worried about keyboard discoverability. If we hide details behind a chevron, we need clear ARIA attributes and a focusable toggle. Sam (Frontend): Proposed snippet: ```
...
``` Milo (Design): That works. Also suggest changing the pill colors — red/green alone are ambiguous for colorblind users. Add a label + icon (check/caution) and increase contrast. Jae (Eng): For preflight probes, we could surface a concise probe log inline (first 2 lines) and then a collapsible "view full log" link to reduce noise. Backend already emits a short summary field we can use. Casey (PM): Good call. For the short summary copy, can we standardize on: "Connection: unreachable / partial / ok" — short, parseable, and fits status analytics. Ava (Product): Microcopy nit: swap "Instance name" hint to "This name appears in billing and logs" (more clear). Also change CTA from "Continue" to "Create & Verify" on this step to set expectations. Milo (Design): Accessibility: screen reader users need updates when the probe finishes. Add aria-live="polite" region for the status line. Sam (Frontend): We'll add a live region. Also, when a prereq fails, set focus to the first actionable item (e.g., SSH key upload) so keyboard users don't have to hunt. Jae (Eng): One caveat: focus transfer can break modal flows. We'll only move focus if no modal is open, otherwise show a brief inline banner with a skip link. Loom-bot: Recording saved: private-wizard-network-ux-review-2045678901 (2:03) Milo (Design): Copy examples for the prereq card: - Title: "Network connectivity" - Summary ok: "All checks passed" - Summary partial: "Some checks returned warnings — click to view" - Failure helptext: "Firewall or NAT may block probes. Confirm port 22 and outbound TLS (443) are allowed." Ava (Product): Love those. Small tone shift: avoid technical jargon in initial helptext — surface the short human step, then an "advanced details" section for commands. Casey (PM): Action items: Sam to implement aria-live + toggle pattern; Jae to expose short probe summary; Milo to update pills/icons and copy; Ava to finalize wording. Ping me when PRs are up. :white_check_mark: Sam (Frontend): I'll send a draft PR by EOD with the live-region + snippet. Jae (Eng): I'll add the summary field to the probe API and include sample responses in the dev docs. Milo (Design): I'll push updated mocks and a dark-mode pass. Ava (Product): Thanks team — want to quick smoke test the flow with keyboard-only and VoiceOver before we merge. Casey (PM): Agreed. Scheduling a 20m QA slot tomorrow 09:30 PT. Invite sent. :calendar:
